name: Tirnach Cabinet 122 EGEO
description: Key Features Compacted-Loess Construction: Built using compacted-loess material, providing natural sound insulation and structural stability. Floor Area: 17 square metres, offering ample space for up to 24 occupants, ideal for group meetings, seminars, or collaborative work. Ultra-Low Noise Floor: Maintains a noise floor of just 12 dBA, ensuring a quiet environment for high-quality speech, audio recording, or focused discussions. Resilient Floating Isolation: Utilizes a resilient floating isolation method to minimize external noise and vibrations, enhancing acoustic performance and privacy. Flexible Session Length: Supports session durations up to 4 hours, making it suitable for both short meetings and extended workshops. Customizable Session Fee: Session fee is determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored pricing based on specific user requirements. Main Benefits Exceptional Acoustic Environment: The combination of compacted-loess construction and resilient floating isolation delivers superior sound clarity, making this room ideal for speech therapy, audio production, or confidential meetings. Spacious and Comfortable: With a 17 m² floor area and a capacity for 24 people, users can comfortably conduct group activities, training sessions, or collaborative projects without feeling cramped. Minimal Distractions: The ultra-low 12 dBA noise floor ensures minimal background noise, supporting concentration and effective communication during sessions. Adaptable Usage: Flexible session lengths and customizable fees accommodate a wide range of scheduling and budget needs, appealing to both individuals and organizations. Privacy and Security: Advanced isolation methods protect against external disturbances, ensuring privacy for sensitive discussions or recordings. Typical Use Cases and Outcomes Professional Speech and Audio Sessions: Perfect for speech therapy, voice coaching, podcast recording, or language classes requiring clear and undisturbed sound. Business Meetings and Workshops: Suitable for board meetings, brainstorming sessions, and team workshops that demand a quiet, focused environment. Educational and Training Events: Accommodates group learning, seminars, and presentations with enough space and acoustic quality for effective instruction. Private Consultations: Provides a secure and confidential setting for counseling, interviews, or sensitive negotiations. Frequently Addressed User Needs Is the room suitable for audio recording or speech therapy? Yes, the low noise floor and advanced isolation make it ideal for any activity requiring pristine sound quality. How many people can the space accommodate? The room comfortably fits up to 24 people, supporting both small and larger group activities. Is the session length flexible? Sessions can last up to 4 hours, with fees tailored to your specific requirements. What makes this room stand out? Its unique compacted-loess construction, resilient floating isolation, and ultra-quiet environment provide a distinct advantage for anyone seeking a professional, distraction-free space.
description_html:
Key Features

  • Compacted-Loess Construction: Built using compacted-loess material, providing natural sound insulation and structural stability.
  • Floor Area: 17 square metres, offering ample space for up to 24 occupants, ideal for group meetings, seminars, or collaborative work.
  • Ultra-Low Noise Floor: Maintains a noise floor of just 12 dBA, ensuring a quiet environment for high-quality speech, audio recording, or focused discussions.
  • Resilient Floating Isolation: Utilizes a resilient floating isolation method to minimize external noise and vibrations, enhancing acoustic performance and privacy.
  • Flexible Session Length: Supports session durations up to 4 hours, making it suitable for both short meetings and extended workshops.
  • Customizable Session Fee: Session fee is determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored pricing based on specific user requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Exceptional Acoustic Environment: The combination of compacted-loess construction and resilient floating isolation delivers superior sound clarity, making this room ideal for speech therapy, audio production, or confidential meetings.
  • Spacious and Comfortable: With a 17 m² floor area and a capacity for 24 people, users can comfortably conduct group activities, training sessions, or collaborative projects without feeling cramped.
  • Minimal Distractions: The ultra-low 12 dBA noise floor ensures minimal background noise, supporting concentration and effective communication during sessions.
  • Adaptable Usage: Flexible session lengths and customizable fees accommodate a wide range of scheduling and budget needs, appealing to both individuals and organizations.
  • Privacy and Security: Advanced isolation methods protect against external disturbances, ensuring privacy for sensitive discussions or recordings.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Professional Speech and Audio Sessions: Perfect for speech therapy, voice coaching, podcast recording, or language classes requiring clear and undisturbed sound.
  • Business Meetings and Workshops: Suitable for board meetings, brainstorming sessions, and team workshops that demand a quiet, focused environment.
  • Educational and Training Events: Accommodates group learning, seminars, and presentations with enough space and acoustic quality for effective instruction.
  • Private Consultations: Provides a secure and confidential setting for counseling, interviews, or sensitive negotiations.

Frequently Addressed User Needs

  • Is the room suitable for audio recording or speech therapy? Yes, the low noise floor and advanced isolation make it ideal for any activity requiring pristine sound quality.
  • How many people can the space accommodate? The room comfortably fits up to 24 people, supporting both small and larger group activities.
  • Is the session length flexible? Sessions can last up to 4 hours, with fees tailored to your specific requirements.
  • What makes this room stand out? Its unique compacted-loess construction, resilient floating isolation, and ultra-quiet environment provide a distinct advantage for anyone seeking a professional, distraction-free space.
